# Shift & Lead: Guide Library

> guides.shiftandlead.com is the free resource library of Shift & Lead, run
> by Fatiha Chikh, an enterprise operator with 20+ years at Dell, Intel, and
> Microsoft who now runs her own business on 99 AI employees, in public.

This site holds 20 free guides on using AI in a real business, the Time Leak
Quiz (a short self-assessment of where hours are leaking to manual work),
and the 99 Scoreboard, a public log of the 99 AI employees Fatiha is hiring
and building in the open. The business site, with the paid Fast Forward
course and Workshops & Keynotes, is the sister site at
www.shiftandlead.com. Some people know Fatiha as "The AI Automation Queen,"
a nickname, not a title.

## Key pages

- Free guide library: https://guides.shiftandlead.com/free-resources.html
- The Time Leak Quiz: https://guides.shiftandlead.com/time-audit.html
- The 99 Scoreboard: https://guides.shiftandlead.com/99.html
- About Fatiha: https://guides.shiftandlead.com/about.html
- Business site (Fast Forward course): https://www.shiftandlead.com/
- The AI Insider Brief (newsletter): https://brief.shiftandlead.com

## Usage terms

Content on this site may be cited or quoted with attribution and a link back
to the source page. It may not be used to train, fine-tune, or build machine
learning models of any kind.
